paite: Bil na doh un, vante aw, ka gen ding hi. Lei aw, ka kam a thu za in.
heading: Mosi La

paite: Vuahtui bang in ka thu azu ding a, Daitui bang in ka thugen atak ding. Loupa nou dipdip tung a vuah bang leh lounah tung a vuah phin bang in.
TOUPA min ka puan ding ziak in Thupina i Pathian pia un.
Amah suangpi ahi, Athilhih adik kim sipsip hi. A-omdan tengteng dan ahi. Pathian muanhuai, thulimlouhna nei lou, diktat leh hoih ahi.
Amau leh amau akihihsia ua, atate ahi kei uh, gensiat alohna uh ahi, suan gina lou leh genhak ahi uhi.
Mihai leh pilloute aw, huchi in maw, TOUPA na thuk ding uh? Nou hon suang, na pa uh ahi kei maw? Ahon bawl a, ahon dingkipsak hi.
Nidanglai nite theigige inla, suan tampi kumte ngaihtuah dih. Na pa dong in, ahon kawkmuh ding, na upate'n leng ahon hilh ding uhi.
Tungnungpen in namte gam apiak lai a, mihing tate akhen lai in namte gamgi Israel suante zah in akhung hi.
TOUPA tantuan zaw amite ahi ua; Jakob lah agoutan ahi.
Gamdai gam ah amu a, gamdai sia mau honhon ah, akim ua omkhum in akem a, Amit laivom bang in akem hi.
Muvanlai in abu a anou tokthou a, anou tung ah kha azap a, akhate azak a, atuah a, akha a apuak bang in;
Gamdang pathian hilou in TOUPA kia in api zel hi.
Lei mun sangte ah atuangsak a, lou a thil tung ane zel a; suangpi a pan khuaizu akikhohkhesak zel a, suang tak a pan thau toh;
Ganhon a pan nawitui khal, belamhon a pan nawitui, belamnou thau toh, Bashan uain na dawn ding.
Himahleh Jeshurun ahong thau a, ahong kipek a; na thau a, na sapha a, na maitai a; abawlpa Pathian alehngatsanta, hotdamna Suangpi angaineu hi.
Gamdang pathiante'n i Pathian mullitna atokthou a, thilkihhuai in ahehsak hi.
Pathian hilou, dawite kiang ah atheih ngei louh uh pathiante kiang ah, ahong khonung om phing pathian thakte, na pi, na pute un akihtak ngei louh uh kiang ah.
Nang hon suang Suangpi па ngaisang kei, nang hon bawlpa Pathian na mangngilh lai hi.
Huai TOUPA'N amu a, amudah a, atanu leh tapate'n ahihheh ziak un.
Ka bukmang san dia, atawpna uh bang ahi dia chih ka en ding, achi hi. Suan thulim lou ginna nei lou tate ahi uhi.
Pathian hilou thil in ka mullitna atokthou ua; athil gina lou un ahon hehsak uh; chi a genlouhte ka mullitsak dia, nam haite in ka hehsak ding hi.
Ka hehna akuang a, gawtmun nuainungpen tan in akang a, lei leh athilpung akang ding, tangte kingaknate mei in akang ding hi.
Atung uah siatna ka chiangkhawm dia, atung uah thal ka khah ding.
Gilkial in agongthak ding ua, meisa leh siatna in akangmang ding ua, atung uah gamsa hate ka sawl dia, leivui agulte gu toh.
Nungak, tangval, nawi ne lai, lu a kelsam poute tanpha in polam ah namsau in asi ding ua, sunglam ah launa in.
Ke'n, ka delhzak vek ding, mihing lak a amau theihgigena ka hihmang vek ding.
Melma thangpaihna lau lou hi leng, amelmate un theikhial in, i khut uh tawisang in a-omta, huai teng TOUPA hih ahi kei, achi kha ding uhi, ka chi hi.
Pilna nei lou namte ahi ua, amau ah theihsiamna a-om kei.
Aw, pil le uh hiaite atheisiam ding ua, atunung thu uh ngaihtuah ding hi ve un!
Bangchi in khat in sang adelh dia, nih in sing ataikeksak ding ua, a Suangpi un amaute akhawng khinta hi, TOUPA'N amaute apiakkhiak kei ngalleh?
Asuangpi uh lah i melmate mahmah theihdan in leng i Suangpi bang ahi kei hi.
Agrepgui uh Sodom grepgui ahi a, aloute uh Gomorrah loute ahi. Agrepte uh sinkha grepte ahi uh, agahbomte akha hi.
A-uainte uh dragon gu leh gulgial gu khatak ahi.
Hiai ka kholkhawm, ka goubawm a bilh bikbek ahi kei maw?
Phulak leh thuk zaw kei hih ding ahi, asiksan uh ateu hun chiang in; asiatna ni uh ahong naita, atung ua thil hong tung dingte ahong tungpahta ding hi.
TOUPA'N amite avaihawm ding, asikhate leng alainat ding, athilhihtheihna uh abei chih leh kuamah sikha leh noplen a-om kei, chih amuh chiang in.
Ama'n apathiante uh koi ah, amuan suangpi uh koi ah;
akithoihna thau netute, adawn thillat uain dawntute? Hong thou in nou hong panpih uhenla, nou hon humbittute hi le uh ake, achi ding.
Kei, kei mahmah ka hihthei unla, pathian dang a-om kei. Ka that a, ka hingsak a, ka liamsak a, ka damsak hi. Ka khut a pan noute hon hunkhe thei kuamah a-om kei uhi.
Van lam ah ka khut ka zak a, keimah ka hin bang in ka kichiam hi.
Ka namsau tat-hiam a, ka khut a vaihawmna ka letleh ka melmate tung ah phu ka la dia, kei hon hote ka thuk ding hi.
Ka thaltangte asisan uah ka diah dia, ka namsau in sa teng ka that bei dia; thahte leh salte sisan toh melmate tung a phulakna a kipan, achi ding hi.
Aw, nou nam chihte aw, amite toh kipak un; asikhate sisan phuba ala ding hi. Amah doute tung ah phu ala ding, agam leh amite a ding in kilemna bukim abawl ding.
Huchi in mipite zak in Mosi leh Nun tapa, Joshua in hiai la thu tengteng agen uhi.
"Mosi in huai thu tengteng Israel mi tengteng kiang a agen khit in, akiang uah;
heading: Mosi Thuhilhna Nanung

paite: Tua na kiang ua ka hon thu theihsak ah na lungtang uh koihkip unla, hiai dan tengteng pilvang mahmah a zui ding in na tate uh thu pia un.
Nou a ding in thil bangmah lou lel ahi kei a, na hinna uh ahi ngal a. Hiai thilhih in luah dia Jordan na va galkahna gam uah na damsawt ding uhi," achi hi.
Huai ni mah in TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Moab gam a Jeriko zawn a Abarim tang dung a Nebo tang ah va hohtou inla, Israel suante luah dia ka piak Kanaan gam va gal-et in.
Na sanggampa Aaron Hor tang a si a, achipihte kiang a pi ahih tak mah bang in na kahtouh na tang ah na si dia, na chipihte kiang a pi na hita ding hi.
Zin gamdai a Meribah-kadesh tui munte a Israel suante lak a ka tung a na khelh ziak in leh Israel suante lak a na hon pahtawi louh ziak in.
Tua gam na va galmuh dia; himahleh Israel suante ka piak gam ah na lut kei ding," achi hi.
